step1_analysis.description: Three NMOS transistors forming the core of a micropower transconductor. In the full paper context, these are FGMOS devices with capacitively coupled inputs, operating in weak inversion to maximize the gm/Id ratio and minimize power consumption.

paper_reference.title: A 1.25-V Micropower Gm-C Filter Based on FGMOS Transistors Operating in Weak Inversion

gm_id_ratio.description: Transconductance to drain current efficiency (gm/Id), a critical metric for weak inversion operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: In weak inversion, gm/Id approaches 1/(n*Vt). With Vt ~ 26mV at room temp and subthreshold swing factor n ~ 1.3-1.5 for SKY130, max gm/Id is typically 25-30 V^-1.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fundamental semiconductor physics limit at room temperature, consistent across most CMOS nodes including SKY130.

drain_current.description: Drain current per transistor in weak inversion bias.

sky130_expected.calculation: At Vgs = 0.3V (below Vth=0.42V), the transistor is in subthreshold. Current depends exponentially on Vgs.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To maintain weak inversion and micropower operation, Id must be kept very low, typically in the tens to hundreds of nanoamps.

power_consumption.description: Total static power consumption of the transistor array.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With VDD=1.8V and 3 transistors drawing ~50nA each, P = 1.8 * 150nA = 270nW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply. The paper achieved 1uW at 1.25V; similar micropower levels are expected here.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure weak inversion characteristics (gm, Id, gm/Id) and power consumption of the NMOS array.
step3_testbench.spice:
* FGMOS Transconductor NMOS Array Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 IP N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 IN N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 IC N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Supply and Drain Bias
V_IP IP 0 DC 1.8
V_IN IN 0 DC 1.8
V_IC IC 0 DC 1.8

* Gate Bias (Weak Inversion Region)
V_N3 N3 0 DC 0.3
V_N0 N0 0 DC 0.3
V_N2 N2 0 DC 0.3

.control
  * 1. Operating Point for Power Consumption
  op
  let id1_op = -i(V_IP)
  let id2_op = -i(V_IN)
  let id3_op = -i(V_IC)
  let total_power = (id1_op + id2_op + id3_op) * 1.8
  print id1_op id2_op id3_op total_power

  * 2. DC Sweep for Weak Inversion Metrics (gm/Id)
  * Sweeping gate voltage from deep subthreshold to near threshold
  dc V_N3 0.1 0.6 0.01
  
  let id1_dc = -i(V_IP)
  * Calculate transconductance (derivative of Id w.r.t sweep variable V_N3)
  let gm1_dc = deriv(id1_dc)
  * Calculate gm/Id efficiency
  let gm_id1 = gm1_dc / id1_dc
  
  * Extract metrics
  meas dc gm_id_max max gm_id1
  meas dc id_at_03V find id1_dc at=0.3
  meas dc gm_at_03V find gm1_dc at=0.3
  meas dc gm_id_at_03V find gm_id1 at=0.3
  
  print gm_id_max id_at_03V gm_id_at_03V
.endc
.end
